    "Highly customizable to fit diverse team workflows and needs.",
    "Offers a vast array of features and views (e.g., List, Board, Calendar) within a single platform.",
    "Efficient and intuitive task creation and management, especially for core actions.",
    "Strong collaboration features for team communication and project updates.",
    "Good value for money compared to other feature-rich project management tools.",
    "Continuous development and addition of new functionalities."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and customization options, can be overwhelming for new users.",
    "UI can feel cluttered or complex, especially with many panels or custom fields open.",
    "Performance issues, such as slow loading times or occasional lag, are commonly reported.",
    "Mobile app functionality and user experience can be less robust or intuitive than the desktop version.",
    "Customization can sometimes be clunky or lack proper guidance, leading to redundant fields or confusing setups.",

pros: Highly customizable to fit diverse team workflows and needs.
Offers a vast array of features and views (e.g., List, Board, Calendar) within a single platform.
Efficient and intuitive task creation and management, especially for core actions.
Strong collaboration features for team communication and project updates.
Good value for money compared to other feature-rich project management tools.
Continuous development and addition of new functionalities.
cons: Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and customization options, can be overwhelming for new users.
UI can feel cluttered or complex, especially with many panels or custom fields open.
Performance issues, such as slow loading times or occasional lag, are commonly reported.
Mobile app functionality and user experience can be less robust or intuitive than the desktop version.
Customization can sometimes be clunky or lack proper guidance, leading to redundant fields or confusing setups.
Reporting capabilities, while present, may not be as advanced or flexible as some users require.
